pages.title: Fallow Deer
pages.text: The fallow deer ($(o)Dama dama$()) is a medium-sized deer native to the eastern Mediterranean and Anatolia, introduced since ancient times across Europe and beyond.$(br2)Bucks grow broad, palmate antlers, unlike the branching antlers of most deer.$(br2)Its coat is unusually variable, ranging from the common chestnut with white spots to pale menil, black and pure white forms.
